name: Bacitracin Zinc and Polymyxin B Sulfate
indications_original: For the treatment of superficial ocular infections involving the conjunctiva and/or cornea caused by organisms susceptible to bacitracin zinc and polymyxin B sulfate.
contraindications_original:
Apply the ointment every 3 or 4 hours for 7 to 10 days, depending on the severity of the infection.
                  
                     FOR OPHTHALMIC USE ONLY
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Product:    50090-3274
                  NDC:    50090-3274-0   3.5 g in a TUBE   /  1  in a  CARTON
adverseReactions_original: This product is contraindicated in those individuals who have shown hypersensitivity to any of its components.
